note: The ten fixed test shots for plan 10 (first three: the 'smoke' set) and plan 10b. Every model and path gets exactly these prompts so results can be compared. Do not edit prompts after the first run; add shots instead.

defaults.resolutionNote: Use the smallest resolution the model supports well, around 832x480, so runs are quick; record what you used with --meta resolution=WxH.

references.brief: Portrait of Maria, a woman in her thirties with short dark hair and a grey streak, wearing a dark wool coat, neutral expression, plain background, soft light.
Portrait of Tom, a weathered man in his fifties with a short grey beard, wearing a yellow rain jacket, neutral expression, plain background, soft light.
An empty ferry deck at dawn, wet wooden planks, white railings, coiled ropes, pale pink sky, calm sea.

shots.title: Harbor at night
shots.prompt: A small fishing harbor at night in steady rain, wet quay reflecting yellow lamps, moored boats rocking gently. Static wide shot, no people.
shots.direction: locked-off camera, low light, soft rain streaks

shots.title: Maria watches the ferry
shots.prompt: Maria stands at the end of a wooden pier at night, looking out at distant ferry lights across dark water. Slow push-in from behind her.
shots.direction: slow push-in, shallow depth of field

shots.title: Ferry deck at dawn
shots.prompt: The empty deck of a ferry at dawn, gulls wheeling overhead, a loose rope swaying. The camera pans slowly left along the railing.
shots.direction: slow pan left, pink morning light

shots.title: Two on the deck
shots.prompt: Maria and Tom stand side by side at the ferry railing in the early morning, talking quietly and looking at the shore. Medium two-shot.

shots.title: "Is anyone there?"
shots.prompt: Close-up of Maria's face as she calls out "Is anyone there?", then turns her head toward a sound off camera. Dim ferry corridor.

shots.title: Tom coils a rope
shots.prompt: Close-up of Tom's weathered hands coiling a thick wet rope on the deck, steady and practiced.

shots.title: Cabin, day
shots.prompt: A small ship's cabin by day: a black iron stove with a kettle steaming on it, a narrow bunk, light through a round window. Static shot, no people.
shots.direction: locked-off camera, warm interior light, steam rising

shots.title: Maria walks to the cabin
shots.prompt: Maria walks away from the camera down a narrow ship corridor toward a closed wooden cabin door. The camera follows her at a steady distance.

shots.title: Tom listens
shots.prompt: Over Maria's shoulder we see Tom sitting in the cabin listening to her, rain running down the round window behind him.

shots.title: The ferry leaves
shots.prompt: A ferry leaves a small harbor at dawn, wake spreading behind it, the camera drifting slowly upward and back to reveal the whole harbor.
shots.direction: slow rising drift, wide, soft sunrise
